title: Datatable: DataTables 3, self contained and themed
summary: The Datatable component now runs on DataTables 3 (no jQuery), loads its own plugins and CSS, uses the layout option, and ships ten new examples.
body:
The [`Datatable`](/components/datatable) component has been rebuilt on **DataTables 3**.

#### What changed

- Runs on DataTables 3 and every extension's latest major version. jQuery is no longer needed
- The component file is self contained. It imports the DataTables CSS for the core and for each extension, so there is nothing to add to your CSS
- The old hand copied stylesheet is gone. The official stylesheets are used and their CSS variables are mapped to your shadcn tokens, so light mode, dark mode and `theme-*` classes work out of the box
- Sort and expand icons no longer load from the network
- PDF export no longer needs the pdfmake CDN scripts in `nuxt.config.ts`. The library is loaded the first time a PDF is created
- Added the **RowGroup** and **RowReorder** extensions
- The examples use the `layout` option instead of `dom`

#### New examples

Column search, row group, row reorder, child rows, export buttons, Ajax, reactive data and custom layout, plus two server-side examples that send search, sorting, paging and an external filter to an API (DummyJSON), with a note on mapping the same request to Strapi.

#### Upgrading

- Replace your copy of the component, then run `npx ui-thing@latest add datatable` to install the new packages
- `dom` still works but is the legacy way to describe the layout. Use `layout` instead
- If you wrote custom CSS, rename the selectors: `.dataTables_wrapper` is now `.dt-container`, `.dataTables_filter` is `.dt-search`, `.paginate_button` is `.dt-paging-button` and so on. The docs list them all
- You can remove the pdfmake `<script>` tags the CLI added to your `nuxt.config.ts` and the `jquery` package if nothing else uses it
- SearchPanes and StateRestore are not available for DataTables 3 yet

```bash
npx ui-thing@latest add datatable
```
